description: This file defines the Imap2Handler class, a wrapper for the imap2 library functions in PHP. It manages IMAP email connections, fetches emails, handles mailboxes, and processes email headers and bodies, providing an interface for IMAP operations within a larger SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: Imap2Handler
classes.description: Wrapper class for functions of imap2 lib, providing methods to interact with IMAP servers for email processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing IMAP handler with logging and charset options.

methods.name: setStream
methods.description: Sets the IMAP connection stream with optional validation.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Retrieves the current IMAP connection stream with validation.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current IMAP connection resource.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if IMAP functions are available in PHP.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens an IMAP mailbox connection using Javanile\Imap2\Connection.

methods.name: setTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for IMAP operations.

methods.name: executeImapCmd
methods.description: Executes an IMAP command with charset handling and error management.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts messages in mailbox based on criteria.

methods.name: getMessageNo
methods.description: Gets message sequence number from UID.

methods.name: getHeaderInfo
methods.description: Fetches header information for a message.

methods.name: fetchHeader
methods.description: Fetches the header of a message.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a message to a mailbox.

methods.name: getUid
methods.description: Retrieves UID for a message number.

methods.name: fetchBody
methods.description: Fetches the body of a message.

methods.name: internalFetchBody
methods.description: Internal function to retrieve message body parts.

methods.name: isValidStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream is a valid Connection object.

methods.name: fetchList
methods.description: Fetches list of emails with specific headers.

methods.name: fetchListWithStructure
methods.description: Fetches list of emails with structure info.

methods.name: getSortedMessageIds
methods.description: Retrieves sorted message IDs based on criteria.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of messages with filtering, sorting, and pagination, also checks for attachments.

methods.name: bodyStructureHasAttachment
methods.description: Determines if email body structure contains attachments.

methods.name: isAttachmentPart
methods.description: Checks if part of email structure is an attachment.

methods.name: getAllIdsSorted
methods.description: Gets all message IDs sorted by a field.
